summary: Retest of iteration 2 fixes on EditMatch + Monitor. CRITICAL BUG FROM ITER 2 IS FIXED: removing one substitution now removes only that entry (5 subs → 4, verified via DOM count). MinuteInput visual clamp is FIXED: typing '25:00' into a sub minute field with halfDuration=20:00 resyncs the input to '20:00' on blur. Stints editor 'Tempos & Parciais' renders with 10 [data-testid^=stints-player-*] wrappers and [data-testid=rebuild-stints-btn]. Monitor half-duration upper clamp works (99 → 60). Only one remaining minor bug: Monitor lower clamp — typing 0 collapses to 20 instead of 1, because the onBlur uses `Number(e.target.value) || 20` and 0 is falsy. Hydration warning from Estatisticas.jsx/EditMatch.jsx (span inside <option>) still shows in console (not blocking).

ui_bugs.issue: Ao escrever 0 e sair (blur), o valor vira 20 em vez de 1. Causa: `Math.max(1, Math.min(60, Math.round(Number(e.target.value) || 20)))` — como Number('0') === 0 é falsy, o `|| 20` transforma-o em 20 antes do clamp. Fix sugerido: substituir por `const n = Number(e.target.value); const clamped = Math.max(1, Math.min(60, Math.round(Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 20)));`
